about: The wild boar's bluff, its tell (HUNTING.md sections 2 and 11, question 1): four poses of the body's own Alert, played by time: the head held low toward its facing with the forelegs braced, a snort, a toss of the head and a stamp of a forefoot (the hoof at the top of its lift in the fourth pose). Until the fight exists a defender only bluffs; only the sounder's leader shows it, a rule of the server.
